notes.title: Demo Update v7: Leaderboards, Replayability & RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Update v7: Leaderboards, Replayability & Subtle Secrets[/h1]

We’ve been busy preparing for our upcoming [b]early access release[/b], but wanted to bring you another cozy chunk of updates! This patch includes a much-requested [b]New Game mode[/b], a shiny new [b]Leaderboard system[/b], and a few quiet additions… if you know where to dig. Before we dig into the details, we are thrilled to announce Cozy Holes will be releasing in Early Access on August 6th, 2025!

[h2]🏁 Start Over, Your Way[/h2]  
– You can now fully restart your adventure with a new “New Game” confirmation option  
– Clear your progress and replay the demo from day one  
– No more waiting for the in-game clock to run out!

[h2]🏆 Leaderboards Are Live[/h2]  
– We’ve launched our first public leaderboard system!  
– Compete for the deepest dig and see how you stack up  
– [b]Whoever holds the top spot on August 6th, 2025[/b] (our early access launch day) will win a free copy of the game!  
– Bonus: Top scores and more details are viewable [url=https://flashpointgames.com/cozy-holes-help]on our website[/url]

[h2]🪐 Something Strange Overhead…[/h2]  
– Some players have reported seeing unusual events in the sky…  
– That’s probably nothing. Keep digging.

[h2]🛠️ Polish, Fixes & New Landmarks[/h2]  
– Visual upgrades and material polish across several areas  
– Lighting tweaks and improved object interaction  
– Continued work on [b]new landmarks[/b] — not all are accessible in the demo, but they’re waiting for you later

---

Thanks again to everyone who’s played and shared feedback. Your support means everything to our tiny team as we prepare for [b]Cozy Holes' early access release on August 6th[/b]! If you haven’t yet, please consider wishlisting the game — it really helps ❤️

🦴 Follow [b]@CozyHoles[/b] on [url=https://x.com/CozyHoles]X (Twitter)[/url]  
📧 contact@flashpointgames.com

notes.title: Demo Update v6: New Settings, Better Performance, and Treasure Merging
notes.content:
[h1]New Settings, Better Performance, and Treasure Merging[/h1]

We’re back with another update! This one adds a full [b]visual settings menu[/b] based on player feedback, improves controller support, and introduces some fun new ways to [b]collect and combine[/b] your treasures. It’s all about player comfort, clarity, and cozy hoarding.

[h2]🐾 Dogby Gets Smarter[/h2]  
– Improved [b]navigation and polish[/b] for Dogby the dog companion  
– Unlocking Dogby now triggers a [b]Steam achievement[/b]  
– You’ll now see a subtle [b]hint when Dogby becomes available[/b], making it easier to find him  

[h2]💎 Collect, Combine, and Stack[/h2]  
Valuables just got a glow-up — and now [i]physics[/i] is part of the fun.  
– [b]Collect items from inside the hut[/b] (finally!)  
– [b]Push matching valuables together[/b] in the world to merge them into larger, more valuable versions  
– New [b]sparkle FX[/b] make successful merges extra satisfying ✨

[h2]🎛️ New Settings Menu[/h2]  
We’ve added a full settings panel to make Cozy Holes more accessible to more players:  
– [b]Camera shake toggle[/b] (on/off — useful for those with motion sensitivity)  
– [b]Fullscreen / windowed[/b] support  
– [b]Resolution selection[/b] with save between sessions  
– [b]Quality level options[/b] (low, medium, high, very high)  
– [b]Music & SFX volume sliders[/b]  

[h2]🎮 Controller & Input Polish[/h2]  
– Added [b]D-pad support[/b] for navigating the UI  
– Improved [b]controller dead zones[/b] for better precision  
– Smoother [b]camera behavior[/b] while digging and exploring  

[h2]🎵 New Music Tracks[/h2]  
– Added [b]new music tracks[/b] to expand the atmosphere and emotional range of the island  

[h2]🧠 UI & Interaction Improvements[/h2]  
– New bottom-of-screen UI messages for clarity on main/settings menus
– Fixed some stuck HUD messages after pausing or returning from menus  

[h2]🐛 Small Fixes & Extras[/h2]  
– Tornadoes now avoid lava and ocean when spawning  & navigating
– Other minor bug fixes
---

Thanks again for playing and sharing your feedback. If you haven’t already, [b]wishlist Cozy Holes[/b] to support the project and stay updated!

🦴 Follow [b]@CozyHoles[/b] on [url=https://x.com/CozyHoles]X (Twitter)[/url]  
📧 contact@flashpointgames.com  
💬 Or jump into the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3616250/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url]

notes.title: Demo Update v5: Climbing Our Way Out
notes.content:
[h1]Demo Update v5: Climb Easier, Run Smoother[/h1]

We heard you loud and clear and are happy to announce a new update addressing your feedback! This update focuses on [b]accessibility and performance[/b] — helping more players explore the island with less friction (and fewer stuck moments).

[h2]🧭 Easier Movement[/h2]
– Refined movement lets you walk up walls when facing them  
– Players can now escape tricky holes without jumping  
– Falling and slope behavior tuned for smoother flow

[h2]⚙️ Performance Upgrades[/h2]
– Optimized terrain and asteroid LODs  
– Improved low-end quality settings  
– Reworked water/rain colliders to prevent unwanted hits

[h2]🐛 Bug Fixes & Polish[/h2]
– Lava now triggers a fade-to-black transition  
– Tornadoes better navigate around terrain  
– New MUSIC!
– Cleaner UI transitions, music triggers, and more


---

Thanks again for playing the demo — we’re continuing to fine-tune based on your feedback!

[b]Follow us[/b] on [url=https://x.com/CozyHoles]X (Twitter)[/url]  
📧 contact@flashpointgames.com

notes.title: Cozy Holes Demo Update v2 – Guided, Polished, and Cozier Than Ever!
notes.content:
Hello again, fellow diggers! 🧡

We’ve just released [b]Demo Update v2[/b], with a special focus on [b]improving clarity, guidance, and overall feel[/b]—all based on the feedback you’ve so generously shared.

Our goal has always been to offer a relaxing, intuitive experience, and this update brings Cozy Holes even closer to that vision.

[h3]What’s New:[/h3]
- Improved UI prompts and upgrade station flow  
- Visual and audio polish for the metal detector  
- More helpful night-time hints and input fixes  
- Smoother jump mechanics and better progress tracking  

We’ve also fine-tuned how upgrades unlock and made sure helpful messages appear when you need them most.

Whether you're digging for the first time or returning for another look—we’d love your thoughts.

[h3]Stay Cozy, Stay Connected:[/h3]
💬 Ways to reach us:
- Follow us on X: @CozyHoles
- Start a thread in the Steam Discussions
- Email us directly: contact@flashpointgames.com
- Or just share your favorite screenshots and tag us!

Oh—and if you’ve snapped a great screenshot, we’d love to see it!

Thanks again for being part of this cozy little adventure. We’re building this with you!
